recent.title: Regular Session
recent.text: Thank you, Mr. President. I rise to thank the Majority Leader for bringing this resolution to the floor to commemorate Women's History Month so that we can take a moment to recognize the multitude of women who have contributed to our great state, to our nation, and to the world at large. For those of you who are fans of golf, the first professional female golfer, Helen Hicks, was born in my Senate…
